history: Same-season strictly prior calendar dates; retain last30 completed games per team, ordered by date then exact game_pk. Predict every game of a date before updating any history. League prior uses all strictly prior season games, both team score observations per game.
formula: For each team offense/allowed histogram count exact nonnegative integer runs in its last30 prior games. Smoothed PMF=(histogram_count+10*league_prior_marginal_PMF)/(retained_team_games+10). Home PMF is arithmetic mean of home offense and away allowed; away PMF is arithmetic mean of away offense and home allowed. Independently convolve exact support without binning, tail truncation or cap to obtain HOME/AWAY/DRAW probabilities.
ml_rule: Condition HOME/AWAY probability on no draw; abstain if non-draw mass is zero. Observed ties are pushes.
threeway_rule: Highest unconditional HOME/AWAY/DRAW probability must be at least0.75. Deterministic tie priority HOME,AWAY,DRAW.
limitations: Independence can misstate game-level covariance. Empirical zero mass, dispersion and tails differ materially from a Poisson mean model, but no probability calibration is claimed. Historical seen development only; no pregame lineup, odds or current-game outcome inputs.
tuning: One frozen design; no grids, confidence changes, team-window changes or result-dependent revisions.
